blockingFindings.title: R6 spec-local ownership test cannot execute
blockingFindings.issue: The new R6 test reads `path.join(repoRoot, ...)`, but this file defines `ROOT` and never defines `repoRoot`. Once the runtime reaches this ownership assertion block, the spec-local test throws a ReferenceError instead of proving that finalize flow.json writes are routed through the single owner.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Replace the three `repoRoot` references in the R6 test with `ROOT`, or define `const repoRoot = ROOT;` before the assertions, then run the spec-local suite so R6 coverage executes successfully.
blockingFindings.rationale: R6 is a mandatory requirement and T-5 explicitly requires static/unit coverage for write ownership. A ReferenceError in the required spec-local test means the implementation cannot provide the required evidence that replaced direct writers are absent and routed through the main-repository owner.
